title: Assistant Manager - Project Management
description:
**Position Title:**
Assistant Manager - Project Management

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**Job Description**

The Assistant Manager - Project Management is responsible for driving the strategic planning, cross-functional coordination, financial oversight, and site execution of multi-million dollar Greenfield and Brownfield manufacturing infrastructure projects. Sitting at the core of project governance, this role defines program roadmaps, manages critical path interdependencies across engineering, legal, construction, and supply chain teams, and acts as the primary liaison for executive leadership, contractors, and regulatory agencies. The incumbent maintains strict financial control over CAPEX budgets, proactively mitigates supply chain and regulatory risks, and ensures all built infrastructure adheres to local building codes, safety protocols, and ESG targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Planning & Roadmapping:**
  Define multi-year project roadmaps, establish critical path milestones, and align interdependencies across engineering, construction, procurement, and legal functions.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Serve as the central point of contact connecting executive leadership, government agencies, municipal authorities, civil contractors, and local community partners.
* **Financial Oversight & Budgeting:**
  Manage multi-million dollar project budgets, oversee CAPEX forecasting, control procurement approvals, and maintain contingency allocation plans.
* **Risk Mitigation & Governance:**
  Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and regulatory risks to formulate actionable "Plan B" contingency scenarios.
* **Quality, ESG & Statutory Compliance:**
  Ensure infrastructure developments comply with local building codes, occupational safety protocols, and corporate Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) targets.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering combined with an MBA.
* **Experience:**
  5+ years of hands-on project management experience executing Greenfield and Brownfield manufacturing facility projects within the automotive sector.
* **Certifications:**
  PMP (Project Management Professional) or PgMP (Program Management Professional) strongly preferred.
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end program governance, CAPEX oversight, statutory/regulatory liaisoning, cross-functional leadership, and PMP/PgMP methodology execution.

title: Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager - Engine Assembly(Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title:**
Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Engine Assembly (Projects & ME)

Location: Satyavedu

**Job Description:**

The Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Engine Assembly (Projects & ME) drives the end-to-end planning, process design, equipment procurement, and commissioning of engine assembly lines. Sitting at the intersection of manufacturing engineering and Industry 4.0, this role reviews engineering drawings, conducts capacity/cycle time studies, designs Poka-Yoke and automation interlocks, and manages the complete machine procurement lifecycle (RFQ to PO release). The incumbent oversees machine proving trials at supplier facilities and on-site, ensures seamless new model ramp-up, resolves quality non-conformances and breakdown issues during stabilization, enforces IMS/safety standards, and implements PLC, robotics, and IIoT digitization initiatives across engine assembly operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Process Planning & Line Balancing:**
  Review engineering drawings to design assembly processes, perform capacity and cycle time studies, and establish baseline manufacturing parameters.
* **Pre-Production & Poka-Yoke Design:**
  Conceptualize processes, evaluate line automation, and implement error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) systems and safety interlocks.
* **Procurement & Machine Proving:**
  Prepare RFQs, execute techno-commercial evaluations, approve machine designs, and lead proving trials at both supplier works and on-site assembly lines.
* **Line Stabilization & Ramp-Up:**
  Drive new model stabilization, verify designed cycle times/capacity, resolve quality non-conformances (NCs), troubleshoot machine breakdowns, and close safety compliance actions.
* **Smart Manufacturing & IMS Governance:**
  Program PLCs/robots, integrate IIoT/digitization frameworks, and maintain Integrated Management System (IMS) documentation.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or Mechatronics from a reputed institution.
* **Experience:**
  5–6 years of relevant hands-on manufacturing engineering experience within the automotive OEM or Tier-1 engine manufacturing sector.
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end machine commissioning, engine proving trials, PLC/Robot programming, Poka-Yoke interlocks, and rapid model ramp-up stabilization.

title: Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title:**
Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME)

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**ob Description**

The Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME) is responsible for the process planning, industrialization, robotic automation, and technical validation of chassis and frame fabrication lines. Sitting at the core of structural manufacturing engineering, this role leads the development of advanced joining processes (MIG, TIG, Resistance, Laser, and Friction Stir Welding), robotic programming (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), WPS/PQR specifications, and metallurgical validation. The incumbent oversees the complete project lifecycle—from DFMEA/PFMEA design reviews and fixture/gauge procurement to Cpk/Ppk trials, PPAP approval, ergonomic line balancing (MOST), and SBP strategic capacity planning—ensuring high weld quality, safety compliance, and zero-defect mass production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Process Planning & Weld Engineering:**
  Formulate Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, WPS/PQR standards, and torch/parameter sequences across manual and robotic joining lines (MIG/TIG/Spot/Laser).
* **Robotic Automation & Line Setup:**
  Program and commission robotic welding cells (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), integrate automated seam tracking, design ergonomic layouts, and optimize cycle times using MOST.
* **Tooling, Jigs & Fixture Development:**
  Conceptualize, procure, and prove out welding jigs, locators, Poka-Yoke clamping mechanisms, gauges, and Special Purpose Machines (SPMs) with vendors.
* **Metallurgical Validation & Quality Control:**
  Perform mechanical testing (tensile, bend, macro/micro, hardness) and NDT inspections to guarantee weld penetration, structural integrity, and IATF 16949 / ISO 3834 compliance.
* **NPD, APQP & Industrialization:**
  Lead cross-functional trials for New Product Development (NPD), execute ECN updates, drive APQP/PPAP sign-offs, and prove line capability (Cpk/Ppk) for mass production readiness.
* **Operational Excellence & Cost Optimization:**
  Drive VA/VE projects, scrap reduction, setup time optimization (SMED), OEE improvements, and long-term Strategic Business Plan (SBP) budget/capacity projections.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Metallurgy, Automotive, or Mechatronics Engineering.

**Experience Requirements by Band:**

* **Senior Engineer:**
  3–6 years of hands-on experience independently managing fabrication process setups, NPD trials, and improvement projects.
* **Deputy Manager:**
  9–12+ years of leadership experience driving SBP long-term roadmaps, mentoring engineering teams, upgrading plant technology, and projecting multi-year capital budgets.

title: Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title:**
Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME)

**Location:**

**Job Description**

The Senior Engineer / Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME) oversees the process engineering, facility readiness, CNC programming, and tooling set-up for critical in-house engine components (Crankcase, Cylinder Head, Cylinder Barrel, Clutch/Magneto Covers, and Crankshafts). The incumbent analyzes engineering blueprints and tolerances to define operational sequences, set cutting parameters, and program Fanuc-controlled CNC machines. This role ensures shop-floor productivity by addressing bottleneck stations, managing special processes (Grinding, Industrial Washing, and Leak Testing), reducing cycle times, driving cost-saving initiatives, and coordinating predictive/preventive maintenance to maintain high facility availability across engine machining operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Blueprint Analysis & Process Planning:**
  Study engineering drawings, specs, and tolerances to determine operational sequences, parameters (speed, feed, cut depth/angle), and fixture setups for engine components.
* **CNC Programming & Tooling Setup:**
  Develop, edit, and optimize CNC programs using Fanuc controllers; select, align, and secure workholding fixtures, cutting tools, and accessories.
* **Special Process & Line Management:**
  Oversee specialized machining operations, including precision grinding, industrial component washing, and high-pressure leak testing equipment.
* **Line Balancing & Bottleneck Optimization:**
  Analyze cycle time, takt time, and throughput to identify critical bottleneck stations and optimize work allocation across the shop floor.
* **Facility Readiness & Maintenance:**
  Support predictive/preventive maintenance routines, ensure continuous machine availability, and resolve field failures and production line issues promptly.
* **Productivity & Continuous Improvement:**
  Drive cost-reduction initiatives, improve line productivity, and apply structured problem-solving methodologies to resolve quality and operational non-conformances.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical or Automotive Engineering.
* **Experience:**
  12+ years of hands-on machining process engineering experience within the automotive OEM or engine manufacturing sector (preferably two-wheeler or light vehicle IC engines).
* **Core Competencies:**
  Fanuc CNC programming, precision component machining, special process machine handling (Grinding/Washing/Leak Testing), takt time optimization, and shop-floor troubleshooting.

title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager  - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)**

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**Job Description:**

The Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Manufacturing Engineering (Vehicle Assembly) is responsible for driving line balancing, process optimization, layout designing, and facility commissioning across vehicle assembly operations. Sitting at the intersection of process engineering and Industry 4.0, this role leads the procurement and integration of tooling, jigs, fixtures, Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) testing facilities, and Low-Cost Automation (LCA) solutions. The incumbent executes line trials, implements ergonomic improvements (REBA/RULA), drives PFMEA and quality non-conformance root cause analysis, and embeds MES/IIoT traceability (Vehicle Genealogy) to ensure high-efficiency, safe, and cost-effective assembly operations up to final handover.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Line Balancing & Process Optimization:**
  Conduct time studies and workflow analyses to eliminate Non-Value-Added (NVA) activities, balancing assembly lines to boost efficiency and operational productivity.
* **Facility & Tooling Development:**
  Design plant layouts for expansions and handle end-to-end procurement (RFQ to DAP trials, site installation, and commissioning) for tools, jigs, fixtures, Poka-Yokes, and ABS testing facilities.
* **Industry 4.0 & Digital Manufacturing:**
  Integrate Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), IIoT networks, and Vehicle Genealogy tracking while executing Low-Cost Automation (LCA) and ergonomic upgrades (REBA/RULA).
* **Quality Governance & PFMEA:**
  Collaborate with Quality to resolve process non-conformances using 8D/A3 tools, update PFMEAs and Control Plans, and create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* **Cross-Functional & Packaging Support:**
  Provide daily shop-floor engineering support, resolve line bottlenecks, drive VAVE/cost-reduction projects, and oversee CKD packaging standards and material handling systems.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Mechatronics Engineering
* **Experience:**
  6–10 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering / process engineering within automotive vehicle assembly environments (OEMs or major Tier-1 system integrators)
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end RFQ-to-commissioning execution, MES/IIoT integration, ABS facility testing, line balancing, and ergonomic workstation design
